title: Prediction of visual impairment in retinitis pigmentosa using deep learning and multimodal fundus images.
summary: Deep learning estimates visual impairment from retinal imaging in retinitis pigmentosa, with external molecularly confirmed patient validation. The paper appeared in British Journal of Ophthalmology. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.

evidence.tested: Deep learning estimates visual impairment from retinal imaging in retinitis pigmentosa, with external molecularly confirmed patient validation.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed study does not establish validation or benefit beyond its reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: A held-out/external cohort tests a visual-acuity threshold classifier from retinal images; sensitivity/specificity and external performance are reported.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
